title: Gorilla Removable Mounting Putty Reusable & Repositionable Adhesive 168 Count Pre-Cut Squares (Pack of 1) Holds 2 lbs. Back to School Supplies for Teachers Students Parents, Indoor Outdoor
features: REMOVABLE HOLD: Securely holds lightweight items up to 2 lbs. without damaging walls - a smarter alternative to traditional tape, push pins, staples and thumbtacks
BACK-TO-SCHOOL ESSENTIAL: A back-to-school must-have for teachers, students and parents -perfect for hanging posters, photos, artwork, signs, lightweight calendars, dorm room décor and more
NEUTRAL COLOR: Blends into walls for a seamless no-trace look before and after use
NO MESS: Solvent-free, low-residue putty applies easily and comes off clean when it's time to remove
168 PRE-CUT SQUARES: Includes 168 pre-cut squares ready to use straight from the pack! No kneading required, making it easy for teachers, students and parents to tackle projects right away
MULTI-SURFACE: Works on paper, painted walls, wood, tile, metal, posters, plastic and glass for indoor and temporary outdoor use
